summary: atmosphere alarm panels / motion camera changes

comments.content:
use wirecutters on atmos alert panels to turn them off (and clear a current
alarm if applic)

you now need to use a screwdriver with a 10 second sleep (much like
breaking down an rwall) before you can wirecut a camera/motion (just
walking in and snipping a wire is a bit of a stretch for what is an
important enough area to keep a motion tracker in)

also fixes up the camera order on the map- weasello et al will need to
incorporate this into the next map they send up to you (who the hell set
c_tag_order on the damn cameras anyway)
